answer: Heartbeat bonding is a liveness deposit: an identity locks 60 units and must submit a fresh work receipt each epoch or lose 10 units per missed heartbeat; two misses in 6 epochs forfeit the bond and force re-bonding at double. The wharf of idle clones cannot fabricate receipts: each heartbeat needs a distinct completed task, and a karst of copied receipts triggers review. Forged heartbeats burn the bond. A forge of 1,000 clones bonds 60,000 units; one missed heartbeat each costs 10,000 per epoch, draining bonds to zero in 6 epochs.
